obligation_matrix.scope: One selected participant per binding; repeated variable identity preserved; aggregate retains full population.
obligation_matrix.instance_count: Selected logical instances counted once in Project context; unresolved population is error.
obligation_matrix.property_count: Named Property occurrence counted on corresponding bearer; max one per named Property per bearer, not per Project.
obligation_matrix.recursive_properties: $node.** selects Properties of the selected Node instance; inherited Property schema identity is preserved.
obligation_matrix.identity: Property instance INSTANCE_OF model Property and IS_PROPERTY_OF its actual data bearer, including Property bearers; mismatched pairs invalid, no Cartesian links.
obligation_matrix.presence: Positive direct-value minimum requires occurrence; zero alone does not; existing occurrence and value constraints remain.
obligation_matrix.IF: MODEL membership preserves selected or outer-bound identity, semicolon-separated nested conclusions, no creation; FOR EACH remains separate.
obligation_matrix.union: OR kind alternatives produce one participant over their union.
obligation_matrix.aggregate: MAX(VALUES(...)) operates over all matching direct values; conditions use AND.
obligation_matrix.direction: Existing link tests and per-endpoint counts do not create facts or grant inverse permissions.

limitations: Preview only; native Draft unchanged. Filter conjunction does not change commas in in-list syntax.
